summary: Manual MCP descriptor authoring and static descriptor analysis exist; live server discovery and hosted execution do not.
worksToday: Authors governed descriptor files from explicit tool declarations.
Analyzes descriptor files for tool-schema posture.
limitations: Does not inspect a live MCP server.
Does not host or autonomously build an MCP implementation.
supportedEnvironments: Windows, Linux, and macOS source builds
installation: Build from source with cargo build -p elegy-mcp.
invocation: Run elegy-mcp author or elegy-mcp analyze.

evidence.summary: The local plugin package passed structural verification.
